brief: Shift pre-operation inspection and material movement staging plan drafted from warehouse equipment telemetry and inbound staging manifests.

slip.document:
# Shift Pre-Operation Inspection and Staging Plan
Facility: Apex Logistics Hub 4, Baytown, TX
Date: 10/14/2026
Operator: Marcus Vance (Badge #4412)
Equipment ID: FL-08 (Sit-down Counterbalance Electric Forklift)

## Equipment Specifications and Telemetry
| Parameter | Specification / Reading |
| --- | --- |
| Rated Capacity (24-inch Load Center) | 5,000 lb |
| Mast Type | 3-Stage Full Free Lift (189 in max) |
| Battery Charge State | 88% |
| Hydraulic Fluid Level | Normal |
| Tire Condition | Solid Pneumatic - No chunking |
| Staging Bay Assignment | Inbound Bay 14 to Racks E-04/E-06 |

## Visual and Operational Checklist
- Overhead guard: Secure, no weld fractures or structural distortion.
- Forks and mast assembly: Locking pins engaged, heel wear under 10%, chains lubricated.
- Hydraulic functions: Smooth lift, lower, tilt, and side-shift operation confirmed.
- Safety devices: Seat switch functional, backup alarm verified at 95 dB.
- Brake system inspection: Operator checked pedal resistance.

## Inbound Pallet Manifest Summary
| Pallet ID | Commodity Description | Unit Weight | Dimensions (L x W x H) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PLT-8801 | Cast Iron Pipe Fittings | 3,850 lb | 48 in x 40 in x 42 in |
| PLT-8802 | Machined Flanges | 5,600 lb | 48 in x 48 in x 46 in |
| PLT-8803 | Galvanized Conduit Bundles | 2,900 lb | 48 in x 42 in x 38 in |

## Staging and Transport Instructions
- Transfer PLT-8801 from Bay 14 to lower rack slot E-04-A, maintaining load height 4 to 6 inches above floor grade during travel.
- Use FL-08 to transport PLT-8802 directly to rack slot E-06-B in a single cycle.
- Move PLT-8803 to aisle staging buffer using standard backward tilt to stabilize the bundle.
- Maintain 5 mph speed limit inside rack aisles and sound horn at cross-aisle blind spots.

errors.quote: Brake system inspection: Operator checked pedal resistance.
errors.explanation: A standard pre-operation brake inspection must verify both service brakes and the parking brake hold capability.
errors.fix: Brake system inspection: Operator checked pedal resistance and confirmed parking brake hold.

errors.quote: Use FL-08 to transport PLT-8802 directly to rack slot E-06-B
errors.explanation: FL-08 has a maximum rated capacity of 5,000 lb, but PLT-8802 weighs 5,600 lb, exceeding the lift capacity.
errors.fix: Flag PLT-8802 for transport using heavy-duty lift FL-02
